inputConvention.base: WineFacts(name: <name>, denomination: <name>, wineType: null, vintage: 2020, level: null); sparklingClassic combinations use vintage null (non vintage: a vintage makes SP_CLASSIC_AGE, BR2.3, tested apart); months profiles use agingStartMonth = 2024-03
inputConvention.qualifier: same with the qualifier word appended to the name (riserva, grand cru, gran reserva, kabinett...)
inputConvention.expectedWindow: start/peak/end are offsets in <unit> from <anchor>; null = not estimated; estimate none = "Da stimare"
inputConvention.level: level null = good: the numbers are the Buono window (BR4.1); presetLevel is the level the preselection proposes (BR4.3) and changes the window only with levelApplies
